arrival.note: Each traffic_class starts at t=0 and staggers with its own Δ. OpenHands and GLM therefore overlap. Replay may override Δ. Counts are frozen session lists, not a renewal process.

gap.glm: inferred: max(0, min(cap, Δstart_time - (response.created - start_time))); cap_s=120.0; split chain if Δstart_time > 180.0s

glm_inference.method: Group by sha256(first user content). Sort by start_time. Adjacent records join a chain iff messages are an exact prefix and Δstart_time <= 180.0s. Keep chains with n_turns >= 2.

prefix_diverse.note: OpenHands trajectories share one scaffold, so at most --max-openhands are kept. GLM chains are inferred sessions; a candidate is rejected if its system LCP with any kept system is >= 64 characters.
